_comment: Copy to config.json and edit for your project. This example is real: it reads the ledgers the thread-sweep and forum-sweep modules write, and filters out the agent-workspace-architecture maintainer's own accounts. 'ledger_paths' are module-relative, so they resolve the same from any directory. Nothing here posts or drafts; check only re-reads threads you already answered and lists the replies you have not seen, and answering one stays a per-comment human decision (see the module README).
